name: Union Hall
notes: StartupCincy Week hub and daily check-in. SCW FAQ: "All attendees should check in each day at Union Hall (1311 Vine Street) before heading to sessions or events at other locations." Parking per the FAQ: Mercer Commons Garage (1310 Vine Street) or Washington Park Garage (1230 Elm Street); no parking validation. The agenda gives no room or venue per session, so only sessions whose own text names Union Hall (room "Beer Hall") or whose official host/application page names it (Cintrifuse Annual Meeting: cintrifuse.com; Student Pitch Competition: the SCW application form) are linked here. Linked events: 4. Coordinates from Nominatim: "Union Hall, 1311, Vine Street, Vine Street Business District, Over-the-Rhine, Cincinnati, Hamilton County, Ohio, 45202, United States".

name: Cincinnati Art Week HQ
notes: Sessions "Out of Office: Fresh Perspectives" (Oct 5 and Oct 7): "This session will meet at the Cincinnat Art Week HQ!" (sic). The SCW site gives no address. The organizer's own page (Cincy Nice, https://www.cincynice.com/founding-circle-rsvp) gives "Location: 1417 Main St. Cincinnati Art Week Temporary HQ + Art Market", and CityBeat (Aug 4 2026) reports Art Week's "new headquarters at 1417 Main St. in Over-the-Rhine" (https://www.citybeat.com/arts/visual-arts/cincinnati-arts-week-launches-october/). Not to be confused with the Art Week Welcome Center / hub at 1600 Race St. (Cincinnati Magazine, Sep 23 2026, https://www.cincinnatimagazine.com/article/cincinnati-art-week/). Same place as the caw slice venue "caw-art-market-hq-1417-main". Linked events: 2. Coordinates from Nominatim: "1417, Main Street, Main Street Business District, Over-the-Rhine, Cincinnati, Hamilton County, Ohio, 45202, United States".
